title: Rooftop solar co-op pitch (synthetic)
audience: The five-member board of an invented housing co-operative (Larkmoor Housing Co-op), deciding at its monthly meeting whether to fund a pilot; financially careful, not technical, in the room with the deck on a meeting-room screen.

core_message.text: Residents on the two south-facing blocks pay more for daytime power than a shared rooftop array would cost them.
A 12-month pilot on two roofs tests savings and upkeep before the co-op commits to every block.
The board is asked to approve the pilot budget at this meeting, with a go or stop review after twelve months.

constraints: Synthetic topic: every fact comes from the research pack, whose figures are invented; never research the topic further and never present it as real.
Arc: problem, stakes, proposal, how the pilot works (one step-built diagram with the shared array as the key tile), risks and the disputed payback, one explicit ask on the final slide.
One stat slide with a single headline number and its unit; one resident quote as a message card, verbatim from the pack.
At most 30 visible words per slide; detail goes to reader notes with sources.
The pilot diagram is new visual language for this deck: prototype it or record the presenter's in-situ choice before building.
Single self-contained HTML file; review at 1920x1080, 1280x720 and 1288x598.
